info.title: Mada Sustainability Real Estate — Public Website API
info.summary: Content and lead-capture API behind madaaqaria.sa
info.description: Read endpoints serve the bilingual content of the website (communities, projects, news, careers, unit transfers…). `POST /submissions/{kind}` receives every form. Admins can also create, replace, update and delete news, projects, jobs, partners, FAQs and opportunities on those same resource paths (session required). `/dashboard/*` powers the internal dashboard at /dashboard and requires a session from `POST /auth/login`. All text fields are bilingual objects `{ ar, en }`; the client picks the language. Until the backend ships, the front-end answers these routes from a mock (in-browser, or served by the Vite dev server at `/api/v1`).
